name: Yokoi Shōichi

names.name: Shoichi Yokoi

roles.title: Holdout in the interior of Guam

summary: A tailor from Aichi conscripted in 1941 and sent to Guam, where the garrison was destroyed in August 1944. He went into the jungle and stayed there for twenty-eight years, living for most of them alone in a cave he had dug beside a river, wearing cloth he wove from tree bark on a loom he made. Two fishermen found him in January 1972. He came home to a country he did not recognise and said the sentence that made him famous — that he was ashamed to have returned alive — and it is worth setting beside the men who went over the cliffs at Marpi Point, because it is the same instruction, obeyed by a conscript who had wanted none of it.
